name: gamenumerics
description: 17 deterministic tools for game numerical design & balance auditing: import xlsx config tables, audit growth curves, simulate battle/gacha, and reverse-engineer spreadsheet formulas — zero LLM guessing.

workspacesDir.title: Workspaces Directory
workspacesDir.description: Workspace root directory where imported xlsx tables land (default: ~/.gamenumerics/workspaces). Mapped to the GND_WORKSPACES_DIR environment variable.

tools.name: import_xlsx
tools.description: Import a local xlsx file and create a workspace: dual-row header merge, numeric column pattern detection (arithmetic/geometric/constant)

xlsxPath.description: Absolute path to the local xlsx file

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all available workspaces under the workspaces root

tools.name: set_workspace
tools.description: Switch the current workspace; subsequent numeric tools operate on it

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all numeric tables in the current workspace (name/module/rows/columns)

tools.name: read_table
tools.description: Read rows from a table with column selection, filtering, and pagination

tools.name: battle_simulate
tools.description: Deterministic battle simulation: player vs enemy panel trade-off, kill turns, bite ratio, Monte Carlo win rate

tools.name: simulate_gacha
tools.description: Gacha probability: tiered pools and pity-based drawing with Monte Carlo simulation

tools.name: compute_power
tools.description: Attribute panel to power rating via the EHP×EDPS analytical model, with marginal value per attribute

tools.name: power_curve
tools.description: Batch power curve over a growth table (level → power), with shape summary

tools.name: eval_formula
tools.description: Deterministically evaluate a numeric formula expression (arithmetic/power/parentheses/variables)

tools.name: audit_column
tools.description: Column audit: recompute each row against an anchor formula and report deviations (hand-tuned breakpoints)

tools.name: infer_column_rule
tools.description: Reverse-infer a column's generation rule (Theil-Sen robust fitting for linear/geometric/power-law curves)

tools.name: infer_table_relation
tools.description: Infer derived column relations (base × coefficient structures) within a table

tools.name: grade_workspace
tools.description: Grade the workspace's numeric-table regularity (A/B/C levels with coverage rates)

tools.name: profile_table
tools.description: Single-table structural profile: types, monotonicity, primary-key candidates, role candidates

tools.name: infer_foreign_keys
tools.description: Infer foreign-key relations between tables via value-domain containment

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read the workspace memory files (PROFILE.md / facts.md)
